name: aparser
description: Bridge to your own self-hosted A-Parser: SERP, suggests and 150+ parsers via its HTTP API. Read-only; needs your own A-Parser licence and server.

APARSER_URL.title: A-Parser API endpoint
APARSER_URL.description: Full URL including the path, e.g. http://IP:9091/API (A-Parser → Settings → API).

APARSER_PASSWORD.title: A-Parser API password
APARSER_PASSWORD.description: Password from the same settings page.
